preprocessing: Official weights transform: RGB, resize [128,171], center crop [112,112], mean [0.43216,0.394666,0.37645], std [0.22803,0.22145,0.216989]
sampling: Uniform 32-frame whole-clip samples; two chronological nonoverlapping 16-frame windows; average pooled encoder vectors
decode_policy: Match prior full pose-cache decodes and sampled frame indices; record header discrepancies without removing clips
limitations: Exploratory crowd evaluation on previously inspected footage. Frozen Kinetics-400 pretraining, two uniformly sampled 16-frame windows and a logistic head; no encoder fine-tuning. This is a pretrained video reference, not reproduction of a published violence benchmark. Pretraining/source overlap has not been audited. Fold SD is descriptive; the folds are dependent. This experiment does not measure RWF transfer or establish independent label correctness.
